person_olga.name: Olga
paragraphs: My name is Olga, and I live in the Netherlands. I love walks by the sea, laughing, travelling and reading. I've completed the five-day trek to the Lost City in Colombia and travelled extensively across Latin America. I'm always happy to share my experiences!

person_daniel.name: Daniel
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Daniel! What do I love most in the world? My family. What do I value most? Freedom.

I'm fascinated by the emerging decentralised economy, high-tech projects and the metaverse. I love blue skies, kissing my daughter's soft, round cheeks, the breeze on a summer evening, my wife's laughter, Andalusia and Mediterranean anchovies. I love my parents, value gender equality and justice, and admire superheroes who need no capes. Sometimes I wish I could stop time just to watch my children and enjoy that very moment.

person_armine.name: Armine
paragraphs: Hi! I'm Armine, from Armenia. Working with Ada Tours introduced me to Brazil and the rest of Latin America, and helped me learn a new profession. I've worked in tourism for six years. I love travelling and discovering new things!

person_iona.name: Ioná Alves
paragraphs: I've studied and worked in tourism since 2009. I chose this field because I love discovering cultures from around the world. The most meaningful part of my job is helping people's dreams come true. I also enjoy reading and active travel.

person_natalia.name: Natalia
person_natalia.role: Sales Manager — Caribbean, Dominican Republic, Cuba and Mexico
paragraphs: Hello! I enjoy putting together even the most challenging trips across the Caribbean and Latin America. My experience helps me design comfortable, varied and safe itineraries. Beyond the main excursions, I include places travellers are unlikely to hear about or visit on a standard tour.

person_alexandra.name: Alexandra
paragraphs: I'm Alexandra, and I live in Brazil. I'd be delighted to organise a memorable journey here or elsewhere in Latin America. I love exploring new places and suggesting unusual routes.

person_giovana.name: Giovana
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Giovana, from Rio de Janeiro. I love my city and enjoy introducing it to others. I chose to study and work in tourism because it brings so many fields together and gives me the chance to help people fulfil their dreams. I love discovering new places, and there is still so much I want to see.

person_nikita.name: Nikita
paragraphs: Hi! I'm Nikita, Ada Tours' operations manager. I'm originally from Moscow, but I live and work with our team in Rio de Janeiro. I love travelling, exploring new places, meeting people and learning new things. I enjoy motorcycling, diving and snowboarding. Working in tourism lets me share my passion for travel and help organise other people's dream trips.

person_geovani.name: Geovani
paragraphs: Hi! I'm Geovani. I graduated from university with a degree in Tourism, and I genuinely love travelling, discovering new cultures and creating experiences people will remember.
I believe every place has a story, and every journey is a chance to discover something new.

At Ada Tours I turn travel ideas into tailor-made itineraries across Latin America. I enjoy combining authentic local experiences with careful planning and attention to detail to create journeys that stay with our guests.
